resumeText:
Arjun Menon | Bengaluru | arjun.menon@example.com

SUMMARY
Technology and cyber risk manager with 10 years across security operations, IT audit and second-line risk.

EXPERIENCE
Technology Risk Manager, Konkan Payments Global Centre, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Lead risk and control self-assessment cycles for technology across four countries.
- Own the risk assessment method and challenge ratings proposed by first-line teams.
- Introduced cyber risk quantification using the FAIR model for the top ten scenarios.
- Keep the centre aligned with the RBI master direction on IT governance and SEBI CSCRF for the broking arm.
- Oversee vendor risk assessment for cloud and payment processors.
- Use NIST CSF as the control baseline for all technology risk reviews.
- Prepare board risk committee papers on cyber risk and overdue issues.
- Managed a team of 4 risk analysts and set their review calendar.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with CIO, CISO and business heads on remediation.

Information Security Analyst, Malabar Bank, Kochi (2016 - 2021)
- Ran vulnerability tracking and supported RBI cyber audits.

CERTIFICATIONS
CRISC, CISA

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, NIT Calicut, 2016
